Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MS.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.69 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2023.
We generated $12.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 5% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 20 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
